rule: An enum constant `E.C` has type `E`. | **Rust**: no module prefix: `Type#method` (impl and trait methods), free functions bare; module paths keep `::` (`std::env::var`); `Type::assoc` → `Type#assoc`.
notes: Layout: src/ (the scan root) holds a Cargo package, Cargo.toml plus src/*.rs, so module paths are crate-relative. Dir::North / Dir::South are enum constants of type Dir (decision A) → Dir#flip / Dir#label high. The variants in match patterns and arm values are data, not calls. call_type: SPEC lists direct|method without defining them; this corpus uses method for every callee of the form Type#m / recv.m / .m (including path calls Type::assoc()) and direct for free functions, module-path functions and named nested functions.
